create_cron_job.rationale: Creates billable standing automation with caller-selected repository, schedule and commands; auto-deploy defaults to yes. Review plan, schedule and code source.

create_key_value.rationale: Provisions a database with a caller-selected plan, eviction policy and persistence mode (including off). Free-tier creation is still a resource mutation.

create_postgres.rationale: Provisions a database with a caller-selected plan, version and disk size. Review capacity and recurring spend, including omitted/default plan.

create_static_site.rationale: Builds and publishes caller-selected repository content to a public site; auto-deploy defaults to yes.

create_web_service.rationale: Creates public executable infrastructure with a selected plan, repository and build/start commands; auto-deploy defaults to yes.

get_deploy.rationale: Pass-through (read): Deployment metadata for a specified service and deploy.

get_key_value.rationale: Pass-through (read): Database configuration without connection credentials; upstream returns KeyValueDetail, not KeyValueConnectionInfo.

get_metrics.rationale: Pass-through (read): Filtered performance metrics; resourceId is an identifier, not a URL or executable expression.

get_postgres.rationale: Pass-through (read): Database configuration without password or connection URI; upstream returns PostgresDetail, not PostgresConnectionInfo.

get_selected_workspace.rationale: Pass-through (read): Reads only the current session fallback; does not report request-scoped workspaceId.

get_service.rationale: Pass-through (read): Service configuration; does not call the environment-variable or credential endpoints.

list_deploys.rationale: Pass-through (read): Paginated deployment history for a service.

list_events.rationale: Pass-through (read): Service event history, including plan_changed events; observing events cannot change a plan.

list_key_value.rationale: Pass-through (read): Database inventory without connection credentials.

list_log_label_values.rationale: Pass-through (read): Log label values; path and text are log filters, not filesystem paths or commands.

list_logs.rationale: Pass-through (read): Filtered service logs; path/text/resource are query filters, not execution or file-write primitives. Applications must avoid logging secrets.

list_postgres_instances.rationale: Pass-through (read): Database inventory without connection credentials.

list_services.rationale: Pass-through (read): Service inventory with optional previews; does not select a workspace.

list_workspaces.rationale: Despite its name, automatically sets the selected workspace when exactly one workspace is returned (pkg/owner/tools.go). This mutates the target fallback for subsequent calls.

query_render_postgres.rationale: Accepts unrestricted SQL using database connection credentials obtained internally. Upstream begins a READ ONLY transaction, but SQL can still invoke functions with external effects (for example dblink where installed and authorized); READ ONLY is not a general SQL sandbox. Govern execution, not ordinary data sensitivity.

select_workspace.rationale: Changes persisted/session workspace fallback and therefore the target of later calls lacking workspaceId. Govern re-targeting even though this tool is deprecated.

trigger_deploy.rationale: Rebuilds and deploys service code, optionally clearing cache. Affects live service availability and code; recoverable rather than inherently irreversible.

update_environment_variables.rationale: Merges variables by default; replace=true deletes omitted variables, including secrets that may not be recoverable. Both modes trigger a deployment. Success returns deploy metadata, not the existing secret values.
